scope: Fixed development+test workload estimate; no thesis matrix executed
unit: aggregate process CPU-hours (user+system), distinct from elapsed wall time
shared_initial_policy: B1/B2/B3/Psame exact initial prompt/config; otherwise do not reuse
target_cost_floor: Each omitted/rechecked query charged at least original-query mean CPU/wall cost, rather than assuming edited inputs are cheaper
cache_extrapolation_basis: Mean per-source unique exact-key cost over8feasibility cases; no cross-source cache benefit assumed. Not a guarantee of final diagnostic-layout cost.
runtime_enforcement: Checkpoint before24process CPU-hours; preserve pending slots and transparently revise allocation rather than drop cases
